name: Channel 1 - Wobbly-style Victorian tales
about: Reference: Wobbly Tales ('Why He Cuts the Rope of His Own Elevator'). Peach-skinned big-nose cartoon Victorians (top hats, moustaches, uniforms) in 3D Victorian places: stone towns, steam railways, mines, mills; warm sunset light; 'Why he did a strange thing' history tricks, 60-75 s.
paint_style: Stylised 3D cartoon render of a Victorian scene, warm golden sunset light, saturated colours
formula: hook: the strange act itself on screen + 'Why did he...?' question
the world before: how things worked and why it was fine
the change that breaks it (train, machine, crowd), quick cuts of trouble
WAIT... the mocker/stubborn one, then the clever fix
payoff: the fix is still there today; last line loops to the first
